name: Siternet Persian Date Converter
author: Siternet

sections.description:
Siternet Persian Date Converter automatically converts all Gregorian dates to the Persian (Jalali / Shamsi) calendar throughout your WordPress site and admin panel.

Features

  • Converts all dates site-wide to the Persian (Jalali) calendar
  • Supports Persian (Farsi) digits
  • Works in both the frontend and the WordPress admin panel
  • Compatible with PHP 7.4, 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3, and 8.4
  • Includes a lightweight settings screen for enabling the converter and Persian digits in the site and admin
  • Bilingual: displays plugin name and description in Persian when the site language is set to Farsi

Persian Description

This section is provided for Persian-speaking users. The plugin converts all WordPress dates to the Jalali (Shamsi) calendar automatically, supports Persian digits, and works in both the frontend and admin panel.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/siternet-persian-date, or install directly via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Done — all dates are now displayed in the Persian calendar.
sections.faq:
Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes, it converts dates in WooCommerce orders and admin screens as well.

Does it work with PHP 8.4?

Yes, this plugin is fully compatible with PHP 8.4.

Can I disable Persian digits in the admin?

Yes, go to Settings → تاریخ شمسی and toggle the option off.

Does the plugin name appear in Persian on Persian-language sites?

Yes. When your WordPress site language is set to Farsi (fa_IR), the plugin name and description automatically switch to Persian in the admin panel.
